mapper.select: SELECT ranked.preview_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(ranked.source_url, ''), '') AS source_url, ranked.canonical_url, ranked.provider_id, ranked.title, ranked.occurrence_count, ranked.first_occurred_at, ranked.ai_requested, ranked.ai_succeeded FROM ( SELECT event.preview_key, event.source_url, link.canonical_url, COALESCE(event.provider_id, link.provider_id) AS provider_id, link.title, 1 AS occurrence_count, event.occurred_at AS first_occurred_at, event.ai_requested, event.ai_succeeded, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.canonical_url ORDER BY event.occurred_at ASC, event.id ASC ) AS row_number FROM stats_event event JOIN stats_link link ON link.preview_key = event.preview_key WHERE event.event_type = 'PREVIEW_CREATED' AND event.occurred_at >= #{windowStart} AND event.occurred_at < #{windowEnd} AND link.title IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(link.title) != '' ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_number = 1 ORDER BY ranked.first_occurred_at ASC
